role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 树精卫士永远是友善的盟友，他可以让同伴和高塔萌发恢复性的护甲。他在树林中不会显露踪迹，还可以用疯狂生长的植物束缚敌人，同时将敌人的生命渡给附近的盟友。
hero_summary_en: Treant Protector is ever the benevolent ally, sprouting regenerating armor for his cohorts and their fortifications alike. Emerging unseen from among the trees, he binds foes with overgrowth as he leeches health from enemies and into nearby allies.

abilities.name: treant_natures_grasp
abilities.description_zh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少%creep_penalty%%%。
abilities.description_en: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.

abilities.name: treant_leech_seed
abilities.description_zh: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。
abilities.description_en: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
facet_text_en: Leech Seed can be ground targeted, planting a tree that heals allies and damages all enemies in the effect radius for the duration of the ability. Damage to creeps is reduced by %creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%. If the tree is cut down, it immediately re-grows again.
facet_text_zh: 寄生种子可以对地施放，种下一棵树，在技能的持续时间内治疗作用范围内的友军并对敌人造成伤害。对非英雄单位的伤害和治疗均减少%creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%。树被砍掉会立刻长回来。

abilities.name: treant_living_armor
abilities.description_zh: 将目标英雄或建筑笼罩在保护性外壳中，治疗目标并格挡来自玩家控制来源的伤害。每次本技能格挡伤害后，下次的伤害格挡量都会减少。如果伤害格挡量降至0，加成效果会提前移除。
abilities.description_en: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
notes_zh: 低于%damage_block_threshold%点的伤害会被无视。
notes_en: Instances of damage less than %damage_block_threshold% are ignored.

shard_loc.en: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for %passive_reset_cd% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 提升活体护甲的伤害格挡量。树精卫士现在还会被动获得活体护甲的加成效果，%passive_reset_cd%秒内未受到伤害后伤害格挡量会重置。

abilities.name: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
abilities.description_zh: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes_zh: 丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。
notes_en: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

abilities.name: treant_natures_guise
abilities.description_zh: 只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得隐身状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
abilities.description_en: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes_zh: 自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。
notes_en: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

abilities.name: treant_overgrowth
abilities.description_zh: 在树精卫士周围召唤出疯狂生长的伤害性藤条和枝干，造成伤害并且阻止被缠绕的敌人移动、闪烁、进入隐身或攻击。
abilities.description_en: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
notes_zh: 效果无视减益免疫，但是在期间获得减益免疫状态将挣脱控制。
notes_en: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.

scepter_loc.en: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续%bloom_duration%秒。变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。
